description: Telegram's own global search over public channels and groups, by title and handle. Good for seeding a topic; telegram_similar_channels is what expands a seed into a neighbourhood. Short topical words work better than sentences.

format.description: Output shape. "markdown" is compact prose for a model to read; "json" is the raw API response. Default "markdown".

name: telegram_search_channels
title: Search public Telegram channels
